docs.name: outline/talk
docs.text:
- The link is the document
  - The problem
    - A file needs a place to live, an account to reach it, a server to keep it
    - Sharing a file is sharing a place
  - The idea
    - Put the whole document after the # in the address
    - Nothing is sent anywhere; the browser never shares the fragment
    - Copy the link and you have copied the file
  - What it means
    - No sign-up, no saving, no servers to trust
    - A document is as private as the link
    - Try it: tinylittleoffice.com

docs.name: outline/book
docs.text:
- The Lighthouse Keeper
  - Part one: Arrival
    - Chapter 1: The ferry
      - Mara takes the last ferry of the season to the island
    - Chapter 2: The keeper
      - Old Finn shows her the lamp and will not say why he is leaving
  - Part two: Winter
    - Chapter 3: The storm
      - The light fails on the worst night of the year
    - Chapter 4: The letters
      - A box of letters under the stairs, every one unopened
  - Part three: Spring
    - Chapter 5: The first ferry
      - Mara decides whether to be on it

docs.name: outline/decision
docs.text:
- Should we move the office?
  - Stay where we are
    - For: the lease is cheap and everyone knows the way
    - Against: no room for the two people we are hiring
  - Take the floor above
    - For: twice the room, the same address
    - Against: the rent goes up by a third
  - Go remote
    - For: no rent at all; hire anywhere
    - Against: the workshop needs a room with a bench in it
  - Decide by the end of the month {.to label=then}
